task_completion.description: The agent opens the Video Management System (VMS) software.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VMS application window is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The agent selects or views the 'Conveyor Camera' from the resource tree or layout.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The camera name 'Conveyor Camera' is visible in the video tile or the resource panel.

task_completion.description: The agent scrubs through the timeline to find the 'CRITICAL ALERT' red screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The video player shows a bright red screen with the text 'CRITICAL ALERT' visible.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the creation of a bookmark for the identified event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Add Bookmark' or 'Bookmark' dialog box is open on the screen.

task_completion.description: The agent names the bookmark 'Jam Event'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Jam Event' is typed into the Name field of the bookmark dialog.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the bookmark, and it appears on the timeline covering the alert duration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A bookmark icon or colored bar labeled 'Jam Event' is visible on the video timeline corresponding to the red screen duration.

integrity.description: The agent used the VMS GUI to create the bookmark rather than script/terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the VMS timeline and dialog boxes; no terminal windows are used to bypass the UI.

integrity.description: The agent actually navigated the video to find the alert rather than guessing the time.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timeline playhead is seen moving to the specific point where the red screen appears before the bookmark is created.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply search for existing bookmarks but created a new one.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Add Bookmark' dialog is filled out manually by the agent during the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The video is 60 seconds long. A red screen with 'CRITICAL ALERT' appears for 8 seconds between the 10s and 45s marks. The camera must be named 'Conveyor Camera'. The bookmark must be named 'Jam Event'. A timing tolerance of 5 seconds is allowed for the start and end times of the bookmark relative to the actual visual alert.
